paragraphs: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company. It aims to build AI systems that are reliable, interpretable and steerable, and it turns that research into products for businesses, nonprofits and civil society groups.

The company describes a loop of frontier research, safety techniques applied to what it ships, and deployment through partnerships and products. Its models are sold in tiers, with Opus 5 presented as a step change for the Opus tier on coding, agents and professional work. Alongside the models sit purpose-built applications, including Claude Science for researchers.

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation whose stated purpose is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity. Governance runs through a board of directors elected by stockholders together with a Long-Term Benefit Trust. Staff are described as researchers, engineers, policy experts and operational leaders drawn from a range of disciplines.

quote.text: Anthropic is a public benefit corporation dedicated to securing its benefits and mitigating its risks.
